purpose: Check mesh sensitivity at the sampled mid-band minimum and high-frequency endpoint before interpreting the diagnostic
frequency_selection: Use exact three sampled frequencies nearest 1.6 kHz from the retained 17-point sweep, plus 3000 Hz; rounded values above are descriptive only
qualification: Two mesh levels are a sensitivity screen, not proof of convergence or physical accuracy
model: Prescribed equal mid flows, rigid throat, local rho*c mouth impedance; mouth-area mean pressure only
